children: Upbit will terminate market support for Ravencoin (RVN) at 15:00 KST, ending trading in all RVN markets on the announced date. Once the cutoff passes, RVN orders on the exchange can no longer be placed or filled, and holders will need to close positions or move balances elsewhere before support ends.

Upbit is Ravencoin's main Korean liquidity venue, so its withdrawal removes the deepest local order book for RVN. Holders who want to exit or reposition face a hard deadline, and concentrated selling ahead of the cutoff can pressure the price before the delisting takes effect.

After the termination, any remaining RVN on the exchange becomes harder to trade at fair value, so moving balances to wallets or other venues that still list RVN is the practical step before 15:00 KST.
📢 Termination of Market Support for Ravencoin (RVN)

title: Ravencoin: Upbit Ends RVN Market Support - 12 Oct 2026
